h1: 16 oz Custom Cups for Events and Brand Programs
lead: Start with a 16 oz cup when that capacity fits your drink service. Compare the actual cup body, rim, lid configuration and decoration area rather than treating every 16 oz model as the same product.
html:
Capacity is not the print template

Two 16 oz cups can have different shapes and usable print areas. Choose the model first; we prepare your logo layout and a free product mockup on that shape.

Plan the service configuration

Include the lid, straw and packing requirements in your model brief. The product page identifies the listed configuration; your order records the version and components you select.
